title: Expose unbounded edge-covariance norm under arbitrary positive tilts on even cycles
statement: On C_(2q), q>=2, put w=2^(4q) on every edge. The two perfect matchings each weigh w^q, while all nonperfect matchings have total mass at most 2^(2q)w^(q-1), so Pr(|M|<q)<=2^(-2q-1). For F=sum_i(-1)^i X_ei, rotational symmetry gives E F=0 and Var(F)>=(1-2^(-2q-1))q^2. Its coefficient vector has squared norm 2q, giving lambda_max(Cov X)>=(1-2^(-2q-1))*q/2. Thus a dimension-independent covariance bound under ALL positive edge tilts fails for this natural representation, even on cycles. This is not a lower bound against fixed-activity parallel monomer-dimer sampling.
